description: Disable and re-enable projects. Disabling hides a project from the catalog and from lookup by id; both disable and enable are idempotent. Disabling or enabling an unknown project surfaces a not-found / no-history error. A symbol belonging to a disabled project remains reserved and cannot be reused.

--- operation 1 ---
errors:
  - Project foo not found
data:

data:
